Minimal fix:

```elixir
def split(total_cents, n) when n >= 1 do
  share = div(total_cents, n)
  rem = rem(total_cents, n)
  {with_extra, rest} = List.duplicate(share, n) |> Enum.split(rem)
  Enum.map(with_extra, &(&1 + 1)) ++ rest
end
```

```elixir
  rem = rem(total_cents, n)
  List.duplicate(share + 1, rem) ++ List.duplicate(share, n - rem)
end
```

That's minimal and clear. Edge: rem can't exceed n since |rem| < n and rem >= 0 for n > 0. n - rem >= 0. Good.
